gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Noto Sans Palmyrene reads as clean, modern plain sans, its curves stopping short and ascenders compressed. And over a whole page it should feel tidy beneath Dogica's heavy, wide-tracked headings.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-h: Heavy and wide-tracked, Dogica leads with its lowercase nearly capital height. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau follows with open-ended curves and a short step up to capitals, so the two stack smoothly.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Noto Sans PhagsPa reads plainly, its c openings easy to see through. Under Dogica's heavy, wide-tracked headings, the gentle step up to capitals should keep pages flowing without a snag.
